patients.summary: Healthy high school math teacher who joined in 2022. Develops a heliotrope rash and proximal weakness in 2024; dermatology makes a clinical diagnosis of dermatomyositis, rheumatology confirms it in January 2026 (anti-Mi-2, EMG, biopsy) and starts prednisone and methotrexate.

documents.title: New patient call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller would like to transfer her primary care here; her previous doctor retired in the spring. Teaches math at the high school and wants to get in before classes resume. Reviewed membership and that labs/imaging still bill to her PPO. New pt preventive visit set for 8/10 at 9:00. Records release form emailed for her prior office.

social.value: Social, 1-2 glasses of wine per week

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
51 y/o woman establishing care. Prior PCP retired; records requested.

No active complaints. Feels well, walks most evenings, gardens. No chronic conditions and no daily medications.

PMH: none.
PSH: lap cholecystectomy 2014; tubal ligation 1999.
Meds: none.
Allergies: NKDA.
FH: mother - autoimmune thyroiditis; father - hypertension; maternal aunt - rheumatoid arthritis.
SH: teaches high school math. Never smoker. Wine 1-2 glasses a week. No drugs.

ROS: negative except as above. No fatigue, no weight change, no joint pain, no rash.

Exam: Well appearing. HEENT normal. Thyroid not enlarged. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, healed lap scars. Skin without rash. Strength 5/5 throughout. No edema.

PHQ-2 = 0.

Assessment/Plan:
1. Adult preventive care. Screening labs: CBC, CMP, lipids, TSH (mother's thyroid history), A1c. One-time hep C and HIV screen, she agrees.
2. Immunizations: no record of a tetanus booster in 10+ years - Tdap given today. Flu and COVID in the fall. Discussed Shingrix series, she'd like to start after the school year settles.
3. Cancer screening: per her, colonoscopy last year and a mammogram last year were both fine; Pap 2 years ago. Will confirm from records.
4. RTC 1 year, sooner as needed.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Heather - all of your bloodwork from Wednesday came back normal: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, thyroid, sugar (A1c), and cholesterol all in good ranges. Hep C and HIV screens negative. Nothing to change. Enjoy the rest of the summer.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care practice
documents.author: prior PCP office
documents.body:
38 pages received electronically from the patient's previous primary care office (provider retired 2022).

Summary of contents:
- Problem list: none active. Surgical: cholecystectomy 2014, tubal ligation 1999.
- Medications: none.
- Allergies: no known drug allergies.
- Colonoscopy 05/2021, average-risk screening: normal exam to the cecum, no polyps. Repeat in 10 years.
- Screening mammogram 10/2021: BI-RADS 1, negative.
- Pap with HR-HPV co-test 09/2020: NILM, HPV negative.
- Immunizations: influenza yearly; COVID primary series 2021 plus one booster.
- Office notes 2017-2022: annual physicals, unremarkable.

Reviewed and abstracted to chart. HM updated.

documents.title: Immunization visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Came in after school. Screening questions negative, no prior reactions. Influenza quadrivalent 0.5 mL IM L deltoid. Pfizer bivalent booster IM R deltoid. Observed 15 min, felt fine, left ambulatory.

reports.text: Bilateral screening mammogram with tomosynthesis. Comparison: 10/2021 outside study. Breast density: scattered areas of fibroglandular density. No suspicious mass, architectural distortion or calcifications in either breast. Skin and nipples unremarkable.
reports.conclusion: BI-RADS 1: Negative. Routine annual screening recommended.

documents.title: Shingrix #1
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Shingrix dose 1 of 2, 0.5 mL IM L deltoid. Told her to expect a sore arm and maybe a day of feeling run down; she chose a Wednesday so she has Thursday to recover. Dose 2 due in 2-6 months, will book before she leaves.

documents.title: Shingrix #2
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Second Shingrix, R deltoid. After dose 1 she had a tender arm and chills overnight, resolved by the next afternoon - not a contraindication, she wanted to finish the series. Series complete.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam. Doing well. Summer off, back to school in two weeks. Walking 3-4 evenings a week.

No meds. NKDA. FH/SH unchanged from last year.

ROS: no chest pain, dyspnea, GI or GU complaints. No rash, no muscle or joint complaints.

Exam: NAD. Thyroid normal. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen benign. Skin clear. Extremities without edema. Neuro grossly normal, strength normal.

PHQ-2 negative.

A/P: Healthy 52 y/o.
- Labs: CBC, CMP, lipids, A1c.
- Mammogram due in November - order placed.
- Colon screening up to date (2021). Pap/HPV due 2025.
- Shingrix done. Flu and the new COVID shot this fall.
- Back in a year.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Heather, your labs look great - nothing out of range. See you next August. Your mammogram order is in; the imaging center will call to schedule.

documents.title: Flu/COVID
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Flu 0.5 mL IM left arm, 2023-24 COVID (Pfizer) IM right arm. VIS reviewed. No reaction during 15 min wait.

reports.text: Screening tomosynthesis of both breasts compared with 11/2022 and 10/2021. Scattered fibroglandular densities. No new mass, no suspicious calcification, no distortion. Axillary tails unremarkable.
reports.conclusion: Negative mammogram (BI-RADS 1). Return in one year.
